TourAiAssistant: Start an AI chat to ask questions, summarize documents, generate texts and get help with your work — right inside {{sectionName}}.
TourBringFiles: Upload files from your computer or simply drag and drop them anywhere in this window.
TourCreateAnything: Create documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF forms right in your browser — no software needed.
TourFindFast: Search by name, filter by type or author, sort the list and switch between list and tile view.
TourPlacesTrash: {{sectionName}} — deleted files you can still restore.
TourShare: Hover over any file to see quick actions. Click the share icon to grant access to your portal contacts with different permission levels — or create an external link for anyone else.
TourSharedAccess: {{sharedBy}} says who the file came from, {{accessLevel}} says what you can do with it — view, comment or edit. Only the owner can change that.
TourSharedAccessTitle: Who shared it, and what you can do
TourSharedEmpty: Nothing has been shared with you yet. Files and folders will show up here as soon as someone gives you access to them.
TourSharedEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
TourSharedList: Everything other people give you access to lands in {{sectionName}}. Open a file to work on it in your browser — the original stays where it is, so everyone always sees the same version.
